title_zh: 确认代喂猫的份量与关门检查

scenario.label_zh: 确认代喂猫的份量与关门检查
scenario.goal_zh: 核对主人准备的喂食安排，并约定不给额外零食、关门前确认猫的位置

context_zh: 虚构宠物照看交接：照看者按主人留下的既有安排执行，不提供兽医建议。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: The two labelled tubs are for tomorrow: one in the morning and one in the evening.

sentences.speaker: Lucie
sentences.text: He keeps asking for food. Are you sure he won't starve between meals?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: He does that even when he's just eaten. Please use the portions I've left and don't spoil him with extra treats.

sentences.speaker: Lucie
sentences.text: Understood. Is there anything else I should check before I leave?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: He likes hiding in the cupboard. Make sure you don't trap him inside when you shut the door.

sentences.speaker: Lucie
sentences.text: I'll check where he is before closing it, and stick to the two tubs. What if I'm unsure about anything?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Call me rather than guessing. I'll have my phone with me.

sentences.speaker: Lucie
sentences.text: All right. I'll come at eight tomorrow morning for the first visit.

targets.sense_zh: 挨饿；因缺乏食物而受苦
